stories.title: Steelers, fueled by jabs over Rodgers drama, 'come together' to rout Broncos
stories.summary: Turned into a national punchline following Aaron Rodgers' release, the Steelers played with a sense of "urgency" and "anger" Friday night in a 27-6 win over Denver.

stories.title: Baylor expected to hire UTSA's Traylor as Bears' next coach, sources say
stories.summary: Baylor, who fired Dave Aranda last month, is expected to hire UTSA coach Robert Traylor as the school's next coach, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel Friday, hours after the Traylor's Roadrunners improved to 10-2 with a 28-22 win over Tulsa in San Antonio.

stories.title: After one of his worst games as a pro, Broncos' Nix says 'I let the team down'
stories.summary: After one of the most difficult starts of his NFL career, Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said "I let the team down'' in a 27-5 loss to the Steelers on Friday.

stories.title: Columbus dumps Miami, Messi from MLS playoffs with extra-time winner
stories.summary: Defending champions Inter Miami CF were eliminated from the 2026 Major League Soccer playoffs after a 1-0 loss against the Columbus Crew in the second game of the round one best-of-three series on Friday night.

stories.title: 49ers rule QB Purdy (ankle) out; Jones to start vs. Seahawks
stories.summary: 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy (ankle) will not play Sunday against the Seahawks, according to coach Kyle Shanahan, paving the way for Mac Jones to start.
